sourceContext.methodAdaptation: The FAO-56 Example 37 table holds p=0.40 at ETc=6 mm/day. The crop-model-v2 reducer applies its general p adjustment, producing p=0.36. The fixture tests this reducer path and does not reuse Example 37 expected rows or claim source agreement.

limitations: Synthetic production inputs used only to exercise v2 water-stress coupling to dry matter.

evidence.sourceCitation: Synthetic software fixture; no biological claim.

production.purpose: Synthetic inputs isolate the existing v2 water-stress multiplier in the RUE production path; no crop parameter accuracy is claimed.

dailyEnvironment.runtimeProvenanceTags: default; the current test-environment tag union has no synthetic value. The committed fixture itself identifies every daily value as synthetic.

syntheticInputs.pairedControl: The dry and wet configs are identical except rootZone.initialStorageFraction: 105/160 for dry and 1 for wet. Both use the same frozen crop, soil, production parameters, ten-day weather, start event, and management settings.

expected.recurrence: pAdj=0.36; RAW=pAdj*TAW=57.6 mm; Ks=1 when starting depletion <= RAW, otherwise clamp((TAW-depletion)/(TAW-RAW),0,1); actual transpiration=min(storage, ETc*Ks); next storage=storage-actual transpiration; next depletion=TAW-next storage; daily DM gain=4*Ks g/m².
expected.nonWaterStressTerms: Heat and cold are zero because 20–30°C stays inside the frozen tomato 10–32°C range. Nitrogen starts at 600 kg/ha and has a conservative post-run lower bound above 587.7 kg/ha versus a maximum stress threshold of 216 kg/ha; assert heat, cold, and nitrogen stress are zero each day. Open-field v2 RUE production uses water stress as its production multiplier.

tolerances.adjustedPAndReadilyAvailableWater: absolute deviation <=1e-12 for dimensionless p and RAW in mm; direct double-precision arithmetic only
tolerances.dailyTranspirationStorageAndDepletion: absolute deviation <=1e-9 mm; ten-step double-precision recurrence only
tolerances.dailyWaterBalanceResidual: absolute deviation <=1e-9 mm/cell-day; ten-day signed cumulative residual absolute value <=1e-8 mm
tolerances.dailyDryMatterIncrement: absolute deviation <=1e-9 g/m²/day; ten additions accumulated from the preregistered RUE equation only
tolerances.cumulativeDryMatterGain: absolute deviation <=1e-8 g/m²; arithmetic accumulation only
tolerances.exactChecks: Initial dry/wet storage, frozen pTable, active/live/unharvested state, zero heat/cold/nitrogen stress, event counts, summaries, and replayed events/final state/summary are exact; dry gain is strictly below wet gain.
tolerances.scope: These bounds cover software arithmetic only. They are not source-display bounds, crop-model error tolerances, prediction thresholds, or evidence of FAO-56 reference agreement.

notCovered: Positive drainage, infiltration/runoff, capillary rise, and irrigation delivery
Root-depth development or alternative root-depth values
Soil/media variants and full nutrient response
Measured trials or independent reference-model comparison
Crop accuracy, prediction validity, or full A-05 acceptance
